name: Image
usage: Thumbnails in detail pages and forms, cover images, images in messages

props.name: src
props.description: Address of the image, passed to `` as it is.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Text alternative of the image, read by screen readers; it is also the accessible name of the preview button.
Use an empty string only for decorative images without preview.

props.name: placeholder
props.description:
Shown over the image area while it loads: a neutral fill by default; `false` shows nothing. Give the image a
`width` and `height` so that the area keeps its size while loading.

props.name: fallback
props.description:
Shown instead of the image when it fails to load: an image icon and the built-in text ("Failed to load") by
default. A failed image cannot be previewed.

props.name: preview
props.description:
Opens a larger preview on click or `Enter` / `Space`; `false` turns it off. The object form sets the address of
the preview and makes it controlled.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the image fills a `width` × `height` area: `cover` crops it, `contain` shows all of it.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius: `md` for thumbnails in lists and forms, `lg` for cards, `none` for images that fill an area.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the image: a number in pixels or a CSS length.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the image: a number in pixels or a CSS length.

props.name: loading
props.description: `lazy` loads the image only when it comes near the visible area, for long lists of images.

fields.name: src
fields.description: Address of the image shown in the preview, such as a larger version; the `src` of the image by default.

fields.name: onOpenChange
fields.description: Called when the preview opens or closes.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Give the image a `width` and `height`: the placeholder keeps the area while it loads, then the image fades in.
Click it, or press `Enter`, to open the preview on the neutral viewer background.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Fit, radius and no preview
examples.description: `fit="contain"` shows the whole image, `radius` sets the corners and `preview={false}` turns off the preview.

examples.name: States
examples.title: Loading and failed
examples.description:
While loading, a neutral placeholder covers the area; when the image fails to load, a fallback replaces it and the
image cannot be previewed.
